nearBankOutcrop.scope: Three interlocking physical scan pieces forming one exposed local bank outcrop; rigid whole-bank offset follows the revised path boundary
nearBankOutcrop.substrate: Stone bodies extend below the existing water/soil level; the low shoulder and toe interrupt the waterline rather than hovering above it
nearBankOutcrop.geometryTransfer: Original scanned positions, normals and UVs unmodified; rigid pose and one scale factor per stone only
nearBankOutcrop.acceptance: Local modeling candidate, not a photographic match

nearSurfaceReflection.source: Runtime rasterization of actual authored cap/arris vertices. No reference RGB/depth.
nearSurfaceReflection.planeExclusion: Camera-ray intersection with the actual lower stone height/coverage; 16 height intervals and five bisections; mipmapped edge feather.
nearSurfaceReflection.wetCoat: Actual points below the stone-specific shallow spill level receive a water-IOR coat and smoother optical micro-normal. No new water mesh or whole-stone plane.
